description: create a test user dedicated to the DSN-creator self-grant test (DATA-SECURITY.md §3.3), with identity-level ego.dsn.admin already granted at creation time since that's what the /dsns POST route requires to reach CreateDSNHandler at all. This user's name is intentionally NOT {{PERMTESTID}}-suffixed: the apitest query-expression language does not run values through dictionary substitution (only 'value' does), so a later test needs to address 'items.<username>.*' in the @permissions response by a name known at file-authoring time. Cleaned up at the end of this test group like everything else.
